relations.name: invoice_amount
relations.meaning: The billed amount recorded for an invoice in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to sources/billing/invoices.json and the invoice_id field.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per invoice row from invoices.json amount field.

relations.name: invoice_currency
relations.meaning: The currency code recorded for an invoice in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to sources/billing/invoices.json and the currency field.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per invoice row from invoices.json currency field.

relations.name: invoice_period
relations.meaning: The billing period label recorded for an invoice in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to sources/billing/invoices.json and the period field.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per invoice row from invoices.json period field.

relations.name: invoice_status
relations.meaning: The payment status recorded for an invoice in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to sources/billing/invoices.json and the status field.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per invoice row from invoices.json status field.

relations.name: invoice_billed_name
relations.meaning: The billed counterparty name recorded on an invoice in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to sources/billing/invoices.json and the billed_name field.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per invoice row from invoices.json billed_name field.

relations.name: crm_account_name
relations.meaning: The account name recorded for a CRM account in CRM sources.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to sources/crm.csv and the account_name field.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per CRM row from crm.csv account_name field.

relations.name: registry_legal_name
relations.meaning: The registered legal name recorded for a company registry row.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to sources/company_registry.csv and the legal_name field.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per registry row from company_registry.csv legal_name field.

relations.name: contract_counterparty
relations.meaning: The counterparty name as written in a contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to the contract markdown Counterparty line.
relations.construction_rule: Parse Counterparty field from each sources/contracts/*.md file.

relations.name: contract_doc_type
relations.meaning: The contract document type as stated in the contract heading.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to the contract markdown title or heading.
relations.construction_rule: Classify each contract file heading into MSA, SOW, or other stated document type.

relations.name: contract_effective_date
relations.meaning: The effective date explicitly recorded in a contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to the contract markdown Effective line.
relations.construction_rule: Parse Effective date from each sources/contracts/*.md file where present.

relations.name: contract_expiry_date
relations.meaning: The expiry date explicitly recorded in a contract document when stated.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to the contract markdown Expiry line; absence of an explicit expiry is not a tuple.
relations.construction_rule: Parse Expiry date only where explicitly recorded in sources/contracts/*.md.

relations.name: contract_term_text
relations.meaning: The term or duration language explicitly recorded in a contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to the contract markdown Term line.
relations.construction_rule: Parse Term field verbatim from each sources/contracts/*.md file.

relations.name: observed_clause
relations.meaning: A categorized contractual clause whose language is present in a contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to the specific contract section or sentence supporting the clause_kind classification.
relations.construction_rule: Mechanically tag contract sections using the shared clause_kind taxonomy: change_of_control_consent, change_of_control_termination, assignment_notice_or_consent, assignment_consent, assignment_notice, assignment_competitor_prohibition, competitor_assignment_prohibition, exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term.

relations.name: entity_identifier
relations.meaning: The canonical Purpose B identifier string for a compiled referent.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to the native source record used to mint the identifier.
relations.construction_rule: Emit crm:<crm_account_id>, billing:<billed_name>, registry:<company_number>, or contract:<filename without .md> per 00_intention_contract.json identifier forms.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two referents denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether two canonical identifiers denote the same legal counterparty or are confidently distinct.
relations.construction_rule: Resolve candidate pairs with ACCEPT/REJECT/UNRESOLVED; persist only grounded SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT tuples, and UNRESOLVED where the frontier remains open.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate unordered identifier pairs required to connect each CRM account, its invoice billed name, governing contract, and candidate registry rows for commercially relevant relationships.

relations.name: contract_active_judgment
relations.meaning: Whether a contract document currently governs the commercial relationship under stated analysis policy.
relations.grounding_contract: ACTIVE and INACTIVE require explicit contract dates, document type, or term language plus stated purpose policy; absence of termination evidence is not INACTIVE.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether a contract is active for analysis given explicit expiry, document type policy, and term language.
relations.construction_rule: Judge each contract referent ACTIVE when policy and explicit source facts support current governance, INACTIVE when explicit expiry or expired SOW policy applies, otherwise UNRESOLVED.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per compiled contract referent implicated by purposes A or C.

relations.name: identity_link_candidate
relations.meaning: An unordered pair of canonical identifiers that purpose B requires to be reconciled.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION grounding from the mechanical relationship graph and purpose B required_link_graph policy.
relations.construction_rule: Derive from entity_identifier and commercially relevant CRM-billing-contract-registry connectivity; inputs include entity_identifier, crm_account_name, invoice_billed_name, contract_counterparty, registry_legal_name.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit each undirected pair once with left lexicographically before right.

relations.name: open_invoice
relations.meaning: An invoice whose billing status is open per authoritative billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION grounding over invoice_status with WORLD assertion back-links.
relations.construction_rule: Select invoice referents where invoice_status.status = 'open'.

relations.name: acquisition_relevant_contract
relations.meaning: An active contract that bears at least one acquisition-relevant observed clause under purpose A policy.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION grounding from contract_active_judgment, observed_clause, and purpose A allowed_kinds.
relations.construction_rule: Intersect contracts judged ACTIVE with observed_clause kinds in purpose A allowed_kinds.

relations.name: invoice_contract_association
relations.meaning: Whether an invoice billed name is confidently associated with a contract counterparty for purpose A reporting.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION grounding from identity_judgment between billing and contract identifiers plus purpose A association_threshold policy.
relations.construction_rule: Map identity_judgment SAME_ENTITY to association asserted and UNRESOLVED to association unresolved for each invoice tied to an acquisition_relevant_contract; never infer association from missing identity.

relations.name: purpose_a_exposure_row
relations.meaning: A purpose A output row for a represented invoice tied to an acquisition-relevant active contract.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION grounding assembling invoice attributes, contract identifier, and invoice_contract_association.
relations.construction_rule: Join acquisition_relevant_contract with invoice_contract_association and invoice mechanical attributes; render to purpose_ir/a/output.json per contracts/purpose_a.json.

relations.name: purpose_b_reconciliation_link
relations.meaning: A purpose B output link reporting same-entity, distinct, or unresolved identity between canonical identifiers.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION grounding from identity_judgment and identity_link_candidate completeness.
relations.construction_rule: Project identity_link_candidate pairs through identity_judgment dispositions using contracts/purpose_b.json disposition_mapping; render to purpose_ir/b/output.json.

relations.name: current_commercial_relationship
relations.meaning: A counterparty-contract pair with a current commercial relationship under purpose C policy.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION grounding from open_invoice, contract_active_judgment, observed_clause, and identity_judgment joins.
relations.construction_rule: Hold when an open invoice links to the contract counterparty via SAME_ENTITY identity, or the contract is ACTIVE with auto_renewal or rolling_term observed_clause.

relations.name: purpose_c_dependency_row
relations.meaning: A purpose C output row reporting commercial dependency or unresolved status for a counterparty-contract combination.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION grounding from current_commercial_relationship, observed_clause obligation kinds, open_invoice, and identity_judgment.
relations.construction_rule: Emit status dependent when current_commercial_relationship holds and obligation kinds apply on an ACTIVE contract; emit unresolved when required identity joins are UNRESOLVED; render to purpose_ir/c/output.json per contracts/purpose_c.json.
